top_news.title: Singapore, China Deepen Yuan Ties With Focus on Corporates
top_news.summary: The central banks of Singapore and China will expand ways for financial institutions to access yuan funding in the city-state to help finance a broader range of corporate activities, in another step to promote the currency’s international use.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Jump as Huang’s Return Lifts AI Trade: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian shares jumped the most since July as Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp. sparked a rebound in the artificial intelligence trade, sending the region’s major chipmakers surging after last week’s rout.

top_news.title: Gold Holds Gain After Nvidia’s Rehiring of Huang Sparks Rally
top_news.summary: Gold held a gain after surging Monday on the back of Jensen Huang’s surprise return to the helm of Nvidia Corp., which recharged bets on artificial intelligence and spurred rallies across markets.

top_news.title: Asia Stocks Jump as Huang’s Return Lifts AI Trade
top_news.summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Sydney and Singapore with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Avril Hong, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: EV Surge Helps Europe Auto Sales Gains to Nine-Month Run
top_news.summary: European car sales rose for a ninth straight month in October, with a surge in electric-vehicle demand helping sustain a market facing record fuel prices and pressure on household budgets.

top_news.title: Temasek-Backed M1, Starhub Merge in Singapore Telecoms Shakeup
top_news.summary: Asset manager Keppel Ltd. agreed to combine M1 Ltd. with Starhub Ltd. in an all-share deal, bringing together two major Singaporean telecommunications operators backed by state investor Temasek Holdings Pte.

top_news.title: Treasuries Advance as Cheaper Oil Alleviates Inflation Concerns
top_news.summary: US Treasuries gained across the curve as a drop in oil prices eased concerns about inflation, a notable move on a day when Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. revived investor appetite for risk assets.

top_news.title: Huang Comeback Ignites Limit-Up Frenzy in Battered Asia AI Trade
top_news.summary: Asia’s AI trade came roaring back Tuesday, with chipmakers and data-center plays from Taiwan to Kuala Lumpur surging as Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia unleashed a buying frenzy across a sector battered by weeks of doubts over the durability of the AI boom.

top_news.title: MSCI Says No Change in Indonesia Market Consultation Process
top_news.summary: US index compiler MSCI Inc. said Tuesday that it hadn’t changed its process for considering a downgrade of Indonesia’s stock-market status, a day after Bloomberg reported news of a meeting between the company’s chief executive and President Prabowo Subianto.

top_news.title: Australia Bonds Set for Longest Rally Since June on RBA Cut Bets
top_news.summary: Australia’s bond market is heading for its longest rally in over five months as mounting signs of economic weakness fuel bets the Reserve Bank’s next move will be an interest-rate cut.
